reviews.text: We took our baby boy Pierre there for day training and we continue to take him for day care. Revival is the best and our boy LOVES it there! He enjoys all the trainers, and our first trainer, Yennifer, took such good care of him and his needs. When Pierre first got to training, he was so shy and scared. By the end of the training, he was confident and really just a happy dog. We love it here!

Revival is excellent ! Our dog Honey has been involved with Revival since her puppy days including training, daycare, and boarding and we have always been thrilled with the experience. Honey is excited to go and we feel she is always well cared for and safe. It is nice to see her tail start to wag before we even turn onto the street! We also love the communication! Thanks Revival!

Michelle, our puppy-teacher was excellent!
She was always prompt, had great ideas & clearly loves dogs.
We highly recommend her!
Now plays with grandchildren, more non reactive to other animals and people and is more relaxed in familiar environments. Passes right by the neighbors cats.

Updating my review of Revival! We have now had our rambunctious Lab puppy with them for several months. What I love most about Revival West U is the trainer is very accessible for any questions, concerns, tips, and general guidance for an over exuberant puppy. SHOUT OUT TO MICHELLE!! Without a doubt, I can highly recommend Michelle!! And Milik is awesome, as well.
We are so fortunate to have found you.  Thank you for taking care of our fur baby with so much love and attention.  We can now travel with peace of mind knowing she is in good hands.  Thank you!

I did a personal training session which is a house visit and Revival was great. The trainer was not overwhelming, but understanding and allowed us to voice concerns while teaching us some helpful training tips!

We have trusted Revival Dog Training with our Great Dane, Ava, since 2023, and our experience has been nothing short of exceptional.

As dog owners, it is incredibly important to us to know that Ava is safe, comfortable, and genuinely cared for when we have to be away from her. Revival Dog Training has consistently given us that peace of mind. Their staff is phenomenal, and their level of care and communication has always exceeded our expectations.

The entire process is always seamless, professional, and stress-free for both us and Ava. Over the years, Revival Dog Training has earned our complete trust, and we are incredibly grateful to have found a place where we can confidently leave such an important member of our family. We wholeheartedly recommend them!

Revival has been a great place for our new puppy. He’s receiving ongoing day training and their board and train really came in handy for a trip that was planned before we adopted him. I would highly recommend sending your dog here.
Willa loves going to Revival for daycare and overnights too!  She has been going for 2 years now.

Revival Dog Training has been an excellent training and boarding resource for our very rambunctious Portuguese Water Dog. Starting at age 4 months, we sought out positive training for Skipper and have seen steady progress thanks to the very knowledgeable, patient and supportive trainers. We also have enjoyed their boarding services, allowing us to travel with peace of mind. The front desk provides a smooth process whether purchasing services or picking up our pup. We especially love the videos that we receive each day, keeping us in the loop. Skipper is not our first dog so we have experienced other places in the past and Revival is by far the best! Just seeing her eagerly prance in, tail wagging, pretty much says it all!!

Revival has helped rewire my own brain on how I approach my dogs, and dogs I foster. What I appreciate about Revival is they don’t make you depend on them, instead they empower you through their day training program. The way they give you the guidance and tools you need to be able to replicate the desired behavior in your own home without invasive, harmful tools, is something that feels hard to come by these days. From my super fearful rescue pup that would pee or poop himself when you made eye contact, to my foster that would growl when you pet him, they helped me navigate both issues with confidence and understanding. I love the team, the mentality, the approach, they really are on to something here, and it’s making better dog parents.
We took our reactive dog here to be boarded for a few nights. The staff was so wonderful with him and kept us up to date about how he was doing. We will definitely be back.

Baker boarded last week after having a bug and needing extra TLC and meds and a special diet.  I was a wreck leaving him and knew he’d be in great hands with everyone at Revival.  They sent pics of him playing and updates of his eating, energy level and made sure he got his meds too.  Once again they exceeded expectations and I came home to a happy puppy!
Revival was incredible - they were patient with our difficult dog, and we really appreciated the regular updates, recorded training videos, and practical tips to keep working on at home.
Love Revival!  They always take such good care of our dog.

We started our dog with a training package and now do the daycare. He absolutely loves it here, every time we tell him it’s time for daycare he gets so excited. On top of that, the people who work here are so kind. Highly recommend Revival!

It's been over a year and a half  now since I first brought my 8-month-old Golden Retriever mix dog Luna to Revival Dog Training. In that time, I've taken the "Peace on a Leash" group class where we learned techniques for encountering other dogs without excessive reactivity.  I've also signed my dog up for Doggie Daycare two days a week, and Luna seems to be growing in her social and behavioral skills while being able to enjoy the company of other dogs in a controlled, safe environment.  She is maturing and comes home with some of that puppy energy drained while having fun.

I have also been very favorably impressed with the training offerings at Revival.

I  initially had three private lessons for my female Golden mix with Lindsay at my home. She helped me become more sensitive to when my overly reactive dog was beginning to feel stressed on walks so that I could distract her before she got out of control. She also helped me to find a technique for getting my dog to sleep where I want her to.

Because Luna has had such positive experiences at Revival Dog Training, I feel very comfortable leaving her there for  Board and Train when I have to leave town. I especially enjoy the videos they send of Luna's progress.

In general, Revival is very effective because of a caring, skilled staff of trainers and an organized front office.
Auggie (4 yr terrier mix) loves to go to Revival for boarding. I think he gets really good care there.
Excellent boarding facility. Attentive and caring team who sent us daily updates. Highly recommended!!
Not only great training and great people, but very accommodating if you have special scheduling requests. And my dog clearly loves the place and the people. Great training and great day care!
They take great care of our dog, send updates and pictures, good communication!
Revival took care of my dog for 10 days and nights and sent pictures or videos every day to let me know he was all right. He came home in perfect condition.
excellent experience each and every time. We have been through training and continue to come back for boarding! great staff!
Warner’s favorite place for weekend getaways! We never have to worry when he is there, the staff sends updates and takes great care of our gentle giant! Only place I would ever send our big guy!

We got a large middle aged dog from the shelter and quickly realized he needed serious training.  He continuously pulled on the leash so hard he would choke himself on every walk, even in a harness.

We enrolled him in the day training with Jaz, and we've already seen a world of difference after only a handful sessions.  There's still a lot of work to do, but already it's like walking a different dog, and he's rapidly learning and responding to commands.  Every time we drop him off, he's excited to go and seems incredibly happy in all the videos Jaz sends of her working with him.  In the daily video we see what they were working on and shows us how to practice the same commands with him at home.

I expect to keep coming here for a long time.

Edit: One year later and we still come regularly, only now we use the day care and boarding services rather than training.  Our dog is still always excited to arrive, tired when we get home, and does well the few times we've boarded him.  The staff are all amazing, can't recommend this place enough.
We did the board-and-train for our small-breed puppy. She came home happy and eager to show us her new skills. The team at Revival is great and gave her lots of love!

My husband and I are expecting our first baby soon and have had Bennett come to our house to begin basic training for our Pittie. He is extremely caring, effective, and our dog absolutely loves him. Clearly a fantastic business, recommend 10/10!

My dog Georgie has made some very nice improvements since participating in the day training program. The staff really understand her unique needs and targeted the areas I wanted my dog to work on. Georgie is also a really anxious dog, but she was excited and happy to go to Revival, which made me feel good leaving here there during the days
Thank you  💕🐾 …

I have had my dog, Rose, at Revival several times, both for enrichment boarding as well as board and train and day training. My dog is a bit  reactive and they have really taught me and my family ways to calmly re direct; they even kept her at the check in and helped her greet others appropriately. The team is creative and fun to work with. The team there is without a doubt excellent. They are kind, caring, and really know what they are doing. In home lessons come with some of the packages and I was so impressed with the trainers that have taught us in our home in particular.

Awesome place. The staff is amazing and friendly. Bennett is our trainer and can’t say enough great things about him. I’m a protective pet parent, but honestly feel that the staff here take great care of my pup while he’s there. I really trust and highly recommend this location.

Revival Dog Training has been a game changer for our family. Our 4‑year‑old Sheepdog is a very happy dog, but walks had become stressful because he’s so strong and would pull, bark, and react to dogs, people, and even bikes. We started with a one‑on‑one home visit with Bennett, then signed up for the 10‑day day‑training package. The difference has been incredible. He’s noticeably calmer, more attentive, and overall much easier to work with. The communication throughout the process has been excellent, and the homework for us has made everything feel consistent. We’re very happy with his progress and highly recommend Revival.

I love revival! It has been so great for my dog. I have a German shepherd/husky mix that just turned 2 and he is fulll of energy and sometimes I didn’t know how to handle it, but by bringing him to revival I’ve learned so much from having good walks, and just learning each time more on how to work together to have a better relationship with my dog ☺️!

Revival has been not only an amazing training resource, but also a little family for my high maintenance rescue pup, Harley! She loves her trainer, Bennett, who helps teach the both of us how to manage everyday scaries of the world. Thank you, Revival team and trainer Bennett!

My dog did 2-3 trainings at the facility and 3 at home private lessons with Bennett Sharp. I’m very satisfied with the services I received. My dog has improved so much. I am able to take her thru TSA at the airport without her harness and she walks thru the security gate on her own leash free. Now, she has so much self-restraint (not as impulsive) and is so obedient. Also, she doesn’t jump on my house guest anymore. Thanks, Revival!
Thank you 🐾❤️ …

The training, my young dog gets here is phenomenal. After the first day she spent here everyone noticed a difference. The videos that they sent to me show me how to be consistent with how I manage my dog‘s behavior so that we are all on the same page. It’s incredibly helpful. I highly highly recommend Revival.  Plus they patiently answer all of my questions and consistently figure out what’s going on and give me great advice as to how to manage it.

What an amazing place! I send my 17 month old and 9 year old Golden Retrievers to play for the day each week with all of their furry friends. They both run directly to the entrance of Revival each morning they go and come home happily exhausted.
To me, that means they enjoy it.
The staff is fantastic, caring and knowledgeable.

The staff at Revival has shown true interest and caring for our fur baby.  David was a terrific trainer, and he sent us videos each day so we could see what Molly learned and keep up her training at home.  Molly also enjoys daycare and her interaction with other dogs and the staff.  We strongly recommend Revival for your babies, too!

Updated review (10 months later!): we are still loving Revival and our dog Angel is loving revival! The staff is amazing and really cares for our dog! Angel now goes to daycare 1x/week and you can tell how excited she is once she realizes where we are!

Original review: When we adopted our first 1.5yr old rescue, I was overwhelmed about training her and needed professional help. Meeting with Revival about my concerns and needs - I felt heard. Going to their open house and meeting the team was also so sweet. We really love revival and the whole team. Each trainer has been superb and just loves our Angel pup! We’ve seen such a huge difference in our dog and her confidence!

Revival is fantastic. I rescued an abused pitbull labeled as fearful aggressive, and finding a place willing to work with her for boarding and training was incredibly difficult. She was rejected by five programs for failing temperament tests and trials, but Revival gave her a chance. The trainers are patient, kind, and truly dedicated. She’s completed the day training program twice, boarded there multiple times, and still attends occasional day training classes. I’m so grateful for how supportive and helpful everyone at Revival has been. I know she enjoys Revival bc she willing jumps out of the car for drop off! I also appreciate that Revival sends photos and videos of her day! If you have a dog like mine, that most training facilities and boarding facilities will not take, try Revival.

We have had a wonderful experience with Revival’s West U team. We took our Mini dachsund puppy for training classes and some day care and we will continue to take him for some follow up classes and day care as he matures. They make the process super easy and they really did listen to us when we shared areas we were struggling with.
Their trainers are great and Mallory made the logistics super easy for us. We have used day care in other places and the groups were way too big for a tiny dog like Turbo, so we especially love the careful monitoring and pairing of pups.
We would highly recommend!
Thank you 🐾❤️  …

Our dog Aggie loves Revival! Aggie attended the evening group training classes, and the 10 day day-training package. She has learned so much and has a blast every day she goes! The trainers are incredible and send really helpful training videos of them working with your dog each day, and how to continue the training at home.

Hello Jan,

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review. We've carefully reviewed our records and cannot find any history of providing services to you. 

We always strive to deliver excellent service to all our our clients, so we would appreciate the opportunity to better understand your experience. 

Please feel free to contact us directly so we can look into this further.

We have been going to Revival for several years.The staff is friendly, and when boarding, they are conscientious about what their needs are while there. Of course,  we love seeing the pictures they send of them having a great day.
They also love to go there for daycare. As we approach, they start to get excited about being there. Not only do they enjoy playing and being out in the fresh air, It's great because they get to "socialize" with other dogs and basic learning skills are reinforced throughout the day.  Very happy Pups....
We've had a great experience with the day training and day care! Highly recommend!

I’m very impressed with the training provided by Revival and highly recommend them. They took my rescue pug and trained the quirks out of her. The entire family is now able to better communicate with her 🥰

Shibas are notorious for being stubborn and I’m so glad that we enrolled our puppy for 20 days of training at Revival! We initially enrolled our puppy at Petsmart but felt that it wasn’t enough training and tools for our smart little guy. I love the fact that we always received 1-3ish videos of our puppy’s training from that particular day so that we can track his progress! They really care about their reputation and truly care about the dogs and their progress. Thank you again!

The trainers mean well but I did not see any improvements at all. I asked the trainers to prioritize the constant jumping and he still constantly jumps even after the homework I was assigned to do each night. Not only that but his pulling on the leash has gotten twice as bad since the training started even though they did leash training. The people are lovely and very kind but save the money and go elsewhere.

We love Revival. I first brought my Frenchie Finnlin to Revival when he was about 16 weeks. Their training was excellent and he learned quickly. They send you high quality videos of the training they did that day, the socialization and recommendations for use at home. After that, Finnlin moved on to the day care program and has been there for several months. Mallory has been a lifesaver getting him booked or cancelling last minute if he gets sick or something. Are they the cheapest option? No. By a long shot. But in this case, your dog is your family and he is safest at Revival (I know I tried others). This will be our go to for little Finn

EDIT 11/2/25:
Finnlin stayed at the boarding program for the first time for 9 days in October. I probably had more separation anxiety than he did. The took excellent care of him. I got daily updates with photos and videos which reassured me. Now he’s done the training, day care and boarding. 10/10 recommend.

Revival has been the best experience we could ever ask for with regard to training our dog. We have used them for private training, drop-off day training, board and train, and simple boarding. They are professional, thoughtful, and patient. Even when dealing with a (at times) difficult dog with complex issues, like reactivity, they have helped us make so much positive progress. Could not recommend them enough!

Updated review: Our dog LOVED Revival’s training program - she was always so excited to go and didn’t want to come home. It’s been a few weeks since we’ve last been, and she definitely learned a lot however she will not listen if there’s not a treat involved, so I wish the program wasn’t always so treat-heavy. I totally get treats are necessary for learning, but it is hard when I’m out and don’t immediately have a treat on hand. Would definitely recommend still!

Original review:
We love Revival Dog Training and so does our puppy! If it’s not a day for her to come in to Revival, she stares at her leash and the door all morning. Trainer Jaz has been so helpful

I have a 7, soon to be 8, year old pitbull who is reactive, particularly, when people get close to me. And because of this, it's been a big challenge to find a place that will board him. I was introduced to Revival via another vendor last year. In January I booked a private training session with Lindsey, and she was great. I had a 12 day trip booked for August, and wasn't sure what I was going to do about my dog Wayne. I even thought about canceling my trip. But I remembered the great experience with Revival and decided to give it a shot. Wayne's initial campout went so well that I took a weekend trip to New York, and boarded him with Revival,  and that went very well too, which really helped ease my mind prior to my 12 day trip. During the trip they sent me update videos which were great. Since the board and training, I have seen a noticeable improvement in Wayne's behavior when we go out on walks and go to dog-friedly places. I can't thank the team enough for their support with Wayne. I highly recommend Revival to anyone that is looking to board and/or train their dog.
Mallory helped me so much

Revival has been fantastic with our new puppy, Toby. The trainers are patient, friendly, and make every session fun and engaging. Toby has learned so much and we’re very happy with his progress so far.  Highly recommend Revival to anyone with a new puppy!

I have been taking my dog to Revival for their day training program. He gets to work 1:1 with a trainer who focuses on specific goals with him. He gets to go to park and stores with the trainer for real life simulations.
Elvis LOVES Revival-and we do too!! Great communication with owners, whether he’s there for daycare or boarding, and he’s as happy when we pick him up as he is excited to be dropped off.

We have had a great experience at Revival! Copper (golden doodle) started at 4 months with day training and has graduated to doggy daycare and standard boarding. We have zero complaints. During training, they answered all of our questions and even offered training games to involve our young kids. He is such a good dog in large part to his awesome training!

I took my 4 year old Frenchton to Revival in West U for training.  They did a great job with her training and with providing video updates and feedback.  I was very happy with the entire experience and would recommend them to others.

My puppy has done really well with training here. We have mostly worked with trainer Chelsea, who has helped him with “sit”/“down”, learning “place” and loose leash walking. She’s super thorough and has sent supplemental videos when I had questions. I really appreciate the daily videos and updates , as well as instructions on what to work on at home.

We love Revival! We use Revival for both in-home private lessons and their day training. Lindsay was great for our in-home lesson. She helped us achieve success with our dog in one hour that we hadn't been able to do in weeks. One of our dogs was not accepting our new 4 month old puppy, so we needed guidance for how to train them to get them to a point where they are comfortable with each other. We also send our puppy Diesel to day training. He works with Jazz and Lindsay. Jazz sends great recaps every day he's with her! His 'place' training has been stellar -- he really knows that command, and it's helped him relax at home around our other dog (the one who is accepting of him). She's also done plenty of work on basic obedience like down, jumping up/proper greetings, leash walking, and being calm/training with distractions like other dogs around. And he gets time to socialize with other dogs in a safe environment too! Revival has been a huge help to myself and my husband who work full time. I know that Diesel is having a better day than he might at home in his crate or play pen, and he's learning too!

EDIT: Diesel is about a year old now and Revival continues to be a great place for him! He is a very confident dog but can be a bit energetic and the trainers have definitely helped Diesel reign in some of that so that he is very confident and polite out in public and even when playing with other dogs so he doesn't come on too strong! We get compliments any time we take him out somewhere in public for how well behaved he is!

We absolutely love Revival dog training and our trainer, Jaz! Everyone there is super helpful and  accommodating. If you're looking for training or enrichment for your pup, look no further than Revival!

I cannot say enough about Revival and Trainer Jas. Truly everyone from Mallory to the trainers have been extremely patient in answering my questions as well as helping my dog in her training sessions.

I can ask them questions as needed, adjust training focus areas, and trust them with her care. I also appreciated the accountability and homework to help continue the training and pressure learning. The puppy pre-K, Day Training, and Overnight Enrichment (boarding) have made a big difference when adding a new dog to our home.

Revival Dog Training has been great for Rusty! He's definitely making progress and we're seeing positive changes in his behavior. We're looking forward to continuing our work with them. Highly recommend!
My pup, Lucas, began “school” at 5 months old…training a JTR might not be the easiest task, but Revival did it !  And months later, Lucas continues to enjoy his “school” daycare days at Revival!

My sweet puppy has been going to day training at Revival.  He has learned so much from the trainers, especially Bennett.  I am happy to drop him off knowing that he'll be loved and supported during the training.  I also really appreciate the proactive communication and responsiveness from the team at Revival.  So grateful for this resource!

I brought my baby to Revival Dog Training in January and Apollo has been amazing. He was 2 ½ months old when he began his training. He came home after his training and understood all his commands. Sit, stay, come and he no longer walked between my feet. I still bring him to train as a refresher since he’s just a baby. Thank you Revival Dog Training for your amazing work.

Revival is our go-to spot for boarding and training our dog! We have used them for boarding and board and train. Revival staff do an excellent job at communicating with us and sending us daily updates on how our dog is doing. Thank you Revival!
Thank you, Francis 🐾❤️ …

Revival has been a godsend for addressing my five-year-old dog’s reactivity.  If you have a reactive dog, you surely understand the instinctive, mechanical tightening of your grip around the leash when you see a distraction in the distance.  You know your dog is frightened and lashing out, and you really just want to tell her that its going to be alright if she will just calm down!  I cannot tell you the number of walks I have had to cut short because a neighbor’s dog (minding its own business) or a squirrel sent my pup into a tizzy.  I’d spent years trying to go it on my own—watching the YouTube videos, reading the forums, playing all the different reactivity games—only to have mixed success.

But over the past several weeks of sending my girl to Revival I can finally say that I have noticed meaningful, generalized improvement in her reactivity.  Look, she isn’t perfect, and maybe she never will be.  But being able to have her focus back on me when a dog suddenly turned a corner was a monumental win.  And Ill take her staring down a squirrel rather than trying to chase after it any day of the week.  She is just a calmer, more confident dog.  I don't know that any of that would have happened without Revival.

Beyond that, I have found the trainers to be excellent, knowledgeable, and willing to spend extra time to talk through training with me at pick up or via text/email.  I have enjoyed the daily videos that chronicle my pup’s training and empower me with the tools I need to take the training home.

I highly recommend Revival, even for stubborn adult dogs!

Update:  We just had 15 people over for Thanksgiving and my Revival supported dog did a fantastic job! We even had some toddlers over the next day and he did well. His only experience with a toddler was negative and he has held on to that fear. However, this time he managed his anxiety well. Thank you so much Revival for helping my pup live his best life!! (Dec 2024)

My pandemic puppy who missed socialization is being transformed at Revival!! He’s gained so much confidence in public and is learning to be the best dog he can be. I am so grateful to the great staff at Revival!!!

It's two years later and we are still loving Revival!  We now do training AND daycare there!  Our trainer, David, is totally tuned in to my dog and knows just what he needs.  Revival is worth every penny and more.  My dog is a wonderful companion.  He gets along with other dogs, walks well on a leash and is well-behaved inside the house.  We will continue to go to Revival.  David and all the trainers we have had there are wonderful.  Highly recommend

Our pup has been to Revival for more than a year now and she absolutely loves it! From day training where she learnt a lot about basic commands, impulse control, cool tricks, redirecting reactivity etc. to daycare where she gets to play with friends and release her energy without picking up bad habits, Revival has been a great help for us! The fact that our pup is learning and getting trained, and still loves going there tells a lot about how Revival trains the doggies with professionalism and love! We will for sure keep sending Mochi to Revival!

We have LOVED revival dog training for our sweet mini poodle, Dolly. Dolly started in the day training program and now attends their daycare. In day training, Dolly worked with Lindsay, David, and Eleena. Each trainer made really nice, detailed videos showcasing snippets of training throughout the day. What we loved most is that the videos also explained how to reinforce training at home, so we could continue building Dolly's skills! Lindsay even took Dolly out for a special training at a local book store to help her work on training in a different environment. You can tell this team is super knowledgeable about dogs and training and they are super responsive and kind any time we have had questions or concerns. Dolly is always so excited to see the staff at Revival. We are really thankful to have a training/enrichment based daycare for Dolly to go to as well because it helps keep her stimulated and active. I am so protective of our baby Dolly and feel good leaving her at Revival where I know they take good care of our pup. I highly recommend checking out revival if your pup needs help training in any area for your pup!

I can't begin to describe how much growth our 7 month old puppy, Henry, has gained in his time at Revival! We rescued Henry as an 11-week old puppy from a trash pile. He had been abandoned, was emaciated, and clearly had a lot to overcome. We have seen Henry blossom, gain confidence, and become comfortable working with various caring trainers on site. At the start of our 20-day session, Henry was afraid to go into the facility and go with someone he didn't know. Now, he trots right in and is working very well with each of his trainers on very practical lessons that help him become the well-adjusted pup we believe he can be, who is comfortable around humans and dogs. Henry has more incremental work ahead, but we feel that we have a great team assisting him and us in learning the skills he needs, and we need to reinforce at home, to be a great, well-behaved puppy! We're all in.
I love Trainer Jaz, she has been so kind and patient with my baby boy. He has learned so much and she cares about him alot!

Revival is an outstanding dog daycare and training facility. Our one year old puppy Bean has a ton of energy and is easily distracted. They work with her one on one to make sure she learns how to behave with other dogs and people around. Really could not have taken care of her without them!
Alfie does training on Wednesday and we love the work Revival does with him. He is very food motivated and a fast learner! Thank you revival for working with Alfie and helping teach him manners.

Revival has been so great for our Rosie. They helped from 3 months old till now, 1 year, and without their help to transition us and Rosie I don't know how we would have gotten through the early days! Also we rely on them for board and train a lot and they always send me daily videos and updates which makes me feel at ease while I am out of town. Rosie is always in good hands.

Revival Dog Training is the best.  Pistole is a 3-month old puppy.
We wanted to start his training early while he is impressionable.
The board and train program for a couple weeks was just what we need to jump start his (and our) training. We love that they will come to our home for the post-board and train owner's lesson. They will see Pistole in his natural element and help us with ways we can provide the proper level of structure, fun, and freedom for him to grow into a well-behaved dog.

We look forward to additional classes and single-day daycare and train sessions!

I absolutely love Revival and have recommended them to several people I know who have also been happy with their services.  Both of my dogs do daycare there and I can trust the staff to take care of them, despite their food allergies and individual needs. I love that the size of the group is small and that there is a structure to the day. My high energy dog comes home having clearly practiced discipline at the daycare and expended energy but also not super hyper and wound up like I have seen him get at other daycares in the area. Additionally they allow me to drop my dog off early, on my way to the medical campus. Early hours are hard to find and I’m super grateful for them being so accommodating!
Thank you, Julie!  🐾❤️ …
Revival has been wonderful with our little puppy!  Trainer Jazz is so sweet and caring.
David was a fantastic trainer for our golden. The skills he learned from David have stuck which is the sign of a great trainer. We love Revival!!

Revival Dog Training is the best!  My pup Enzo just turned 1 and he is the best boy with the help of the Revival team.  David, Jazz and Gracey have all played a part in building his confidence, improving his socialization and helping him develop his politeness and personality.  He has participated in puppy training, day care and day training at Revival since he joined our family and we couldn't be happier with the results.  He is well rounded, enjoys going everywhere with us and has learned the best manners from going to Revival.  Not to mention how they trained us humans on how to insure success at home!  Thank you Revival and a special shout out to Mallory who is always pleasant and patient with my scheduling needs!
I’ve had a great experience with Revival Dog Training. David has been great training Niko. Their boarding services have also been a big help when we’re out of town.
